UGA.note: Only UCC's warning of consumer risks from unlicensed resellers; no consumer rule for digital finance stated.
Cybersecurity is named only as a UCC concern; no cybercrime law or bill stated.
Nothing on electronic transactions or e-commerce law.

facts.fact: UCC says licensed operators charge about Shs2,000 per gigabyte of internet data, against about Shs1,000 from unlicensed Wi-Fi resellers.
